claims.rationale: Blakers et al. 1989, p. 1363 facsimile, UNSW https://www2.pv.unsw.edu.au/videos/Martin-Green-6March2015/slides/40years_6Mar2015.pdf describes PERC and independently confirmed cell efficiencies up to 22.8%; publication is a conservative upper bound. Result concerns a laboratory cell, not a module; older design and working-cell dates remain unresolved.

LONGi https://www.longi.com/en/news/6818/ paragraphs on 19 April launch and module production reports Shanghai unveiling, bifacial PERC structure and mass production of its 365 W version by 24 April 2017; 8 December manufacturer statement https://www.longi.com/en/news/6995/ gives target demand and Top Runner programs. Manufacturing start, site and volume are not inferred.

The directed adapts link is restricted to design architecture, not transfer of proprietary know-how. Blakers p.1363 describes UNSW PERC; LONGi identifies its own bifacial PERC; independently informative ISFH/Meyer Burger article https://www.pv-tech.org/wp-content/uploads/legacy-publication-pdfs/2c66859154-industrial-implementation-of-bifacial-perc-solar-cells-and-modules.pdf pp.46–48 cites Blakers and describes PERC+ modification, pp.50–51 lists LONGi as an industrial supplier. It acknowledges a LONGi contact for cell results, so this is corroboration of the design relationship rather than independent measurement of Hi-MO2 or a specific transmission pathway.

Invenergy 2020 Impact Report pp.12–13 https://assets.contentstack.io/v3/assets/blt73251bb1f13bbb9d/blt3064c4374318ff9d/63f39597636425106de3ca5d/Invenergy-2020-Impact-Report_2022-06-07-164350_fwei.pdf dates Southern Oak commissioning Q1 2020. Invenergy 2024 BOEM filing pp.29–30 https://www.boem.gov/sites/default/files/documents/renewable-energy/state-activities/GOMW-EOI-Invenergy-GOM-Offshore-Wind-LLC.pdf identifies its Hi-MO2 modules and 2020 COD; 2019 is construction completion. Georgia Power 2018 REDI release https://southerncompany.mediaroom.com/2018-03-13-Georgia-Power-renewable-growth-to-continue-throughout-2018 names Invenergy Camilla project and counterparty. Independently inspected EIA August 2026 preliminary workbook sheet Page 1 row 4508: plant 61785, Camilla Solar Energy Project, Invenergy Services, GA, PV/SUN, CI4508 34774 MWh. Project match is based on overlapping site, operator and procurement evidence, not an explicit EIA alias; whole-plant output is not a module-specific measurement and 2026 equipment inventory is unconfirmed.

Fraunhofer ISE 27 November 2013 release https://www.ise.fraunhofer.de/en/press-media/press-releases/2013/24-prozent-siliciumsolarzelle-auf-n-typ-material.html describes a 24% n-type laboratory cell, continuous rear TOPCon, problem addressed and funding. Bound is announcement date; efficiency is institute reported and not a module or production claim. Industrial transfer remains unlinked.

Inventory distinguishes historical LONGi product production, Southern Oak operation and EIA plant generation from Jinko shipment. Jinko 30 October 2026 financial release https://ir.jinkosolar.com/news-releases/news-release-details/jinko-holdings-announces-third-quarter-2026-financial-results reports >5 GW Tiger Neo 3.0 shipments in Q3; dated 2024 manufacturer release https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/jinkosolar-launches-worlds-most-powerful-residential-and-utility-solar-panels-tiger-neo-3-0--302285286.html identifies TOPCon. No shipment is equated with commissioning or generation. Fraunhofer release and Dullweber pp.46–47 support the alternatives; frontier and screening retain uncertainty.

corrections: Replaced inaccessible Invenergy press URL with accessible operator impact report; corrected Southern Oak 2019 construction versus 2020 commissioning; replaced undated Jinko technology page with dated manufacturer release; corrected Dullweber commercial-module/Table 2 locator to printed pp.50–51.
deferred: Precise original PERC design/measurement dates, named manufacturing transfer and licensing, and Southern Oak 2026 module inventory; no direct Freiburg-to-Jinko link. EIA generation is preliminary and plant-level.
